summary: # CLO 2025 Course: Collaborating with Keduodun to Create a Christmas Couple Outfit ## Introduction Today, I will show you how to make a real Christmas set. In this model, we will use a new feature called Glow2025. It will explain our real-time editor and version generator. ## Creating Needles In the top section, we will show you how to make different types of needles: - **Hollow Needle** - **Thick Needle** - **Needle Without a Gap** We will also demonstrate how to tie a string. ## Editor Overview Let's take a look at the editor. We will create a basic round loop and then modify it. ### Library Window Now, let's open the library window and create a new library. In this material folder, we can access all the materials we have used in the past. Here we have some materials and accessories. ### Importing Files First, we will import the ZPRJ file. This file will be downloaded in Connect shopping. In our official account, we have uploaded a lot of free basic formats that we can use. You can choose free formats and select the official account. ### Gender and Style Selection You can select gender, and there are many different styles here. I will use this model, which is a V1 model. You can click here to join the shopping cart. After the display is added to the shopping cart, it will show that it has been successfully purchased. If we want to use it, we can drag it in directly for use—now it's ready for you, no need to download. ## Modifying Styles Let's change the style now. First of all, we have to make a turned collar. The sleeve also needs to be turned up. Additionally, we will add a small box side at the bottom and make a drawstring. ### Adjusting the Body First, let's deal with the body. We will delete the excess curve points because our normal sweater style consists mostly of straight lines. 1. Shorten the front piece to 80 and confirm. 2. Adjust the back piece to be straighter. 3. Turn up and down the back piece and adjust its size. ### Movement and Curve Adjustments Next, push it by pulling the lever, turn it up or down, and pull it out. Adjust the back piece to make it straighter. Right-click and enter the movement distance as 10. Repeat the same operation for the back piece. ### Bottom Plate Adjustment Now, let's adjust the bottom plate. In the close window, lift it up a little first, then modify it and lengthen it. Enter the overall width with the right key (1430), click OK. We will rearrange this plate again. Open the arrangement point on the model and arrange it on the model's waist. Modify its height and width as needed. ### Curve Point Removal Remove the curve point on the model's waist and treat it as a straight-line shape. Pull it inside on both sides with an angle of about 90 degrees. Lengthen the sleeve by pulling it down by 50, making it wider by 5 cm. ### Sleeve and Decorative Board Creation Next, we will create the little lotus leaf edge of this sleeve using the folding arrangement tool. The width will be 780, and the height will be 23 mm. Use the line sewing tool to sew it to the sleeve. ### Additional Decorations We will also create a decorative board for the shoulder. Draw an inner line, press the Ctrl key to create a curve, and adjust its shape. ## Collar Adjustments Next, delete the original collar and modify its collar line using the panel outline expansion. Set an impact of 25 for the shoulder strap. ### Neck Width Measurement Use the measurement tool to measure the neck width of the model, which is approximately 300 mm (30 cm). Create a half-shape of the collar with a width of 160 cm and a height of 180 cm. ### Collar Simulation Move the collar out a little, right-click to edit the line, and place the collar on the neck of the model. Before simulating, freeze the collar. Sew the collar on both sides and simulate to check the fit. ## Final Adjustments Adjust the internal line borders for both the collar and the back piece. Simulate the overall design and make necessary tweaks. ### Fabric Selection Now, let’s apply the fabric materials. Choose a velvet fabric for the front and a lace fabric for the layers. ## Conclusion This concludes the tutorial on creating a Christmas couple outfit using the CLO 2025 software. Thank you for watching, and I hope you have a wonderful time creating your designs!
